solutions.check: bars rebuilt from the blog's numbered answers (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Money going into drink, leading to depression

indicators.note: one thing going into another ends up inside it, so the money sits within the drink

parts.note: to sup is to drink, and a sup is a mouthful
M is a standard abbreviation for money

explanation.surface: Spending all your cash on alcohol ends in gloom.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Depression' sounds like low spirits, but here it is a physical hollow.
explanation.definitionFit: A sump is a pit or hollow where liquid collects, a literal low point in the ground.

clue.text: Stupid one left with bungled prep right away after school

indicators.note: the remaining pieces come after the opening piece in the answer

parts.note: SCH is the abbreviation for school

indicators.note: something bungled is botched and jumbled, so the remaining letters are put in a new order
the right-hand abbreviation is sent away, so that letter is removed from the word

parts.note: L is the abbreviation for left
taken as written; R for right then leaves it

explanation.surface: A dim pupil is left alone with homework they have messed up after school.
explanation.walkthrough: PREP loses its R, and the PEP left over is jumbled to EPP; R for right and L for left are standard abbreviations.
explanation.definitionFit: Schlep(p), from Yiddish, is slang for a clumsy, foolish or ineffectual person.

clue.text: Palm I prune rising round centre of topiary

indicators.note: in a down clue something rising is read from the bottom up, so the letters run backwards

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: the reversed letters go round, enclosing the next piece

parts.note: to prune a hedge is to trim it

indicators.note: 'centre of' keeps only the middle letter of 'topiary'

parts.note: the middle letter of the seven-letter topiary

explanation.surface: A gardener trims a palm while shaping a piece of topiary.
explanation.walkthrough: I and TRIM read upwards give MIRTI, which then takes in the middle I of topiary.
explanation.definitionFit: The miriti is a South American fan palm, also called the moriche or buriti palm.

clue.text: Murphy that is discounted for seat

indicators.note: something discounted is left out of the reckoning, so these letters are removed

parts.note: a murphy is an Irish slang potato, and pratie is the Irish word for one
i.e. is the abbreviation of id est, that is

explanation.surface: Someone called Murphy has been marked down for a chair.
explanation.walkthrough: Murphy looks like a surname; it is slang for a potato. PRATIE loses IE.
explanation.definitionFit: Prat is an old slang word for the buttocks, the part of the body one sits on.

clue.text: Negotiate screed, penning answer

indicators.note: to pen something is to shut it in, as in a sheep pen, so one piece encloses the other

parts.note: a tract is a lengthy written treatise, like a screed
ANS is the abbreviation for answer

explanation.surface: A diplomat negotiates by writing a long document that includes a reply.
explanation.definitionFit: To transact business is to carry it through or negotiate it to completion.

clue.text: Floor covering I'm lifting after so long

indicators.note: in a down clue lifting moves letters upward, so they are read in reverse
the reversed piece is placed after the farewell in the answer

parts.note: ta-ta is a casual goodbye, like so long
I'm without the apostrophe, read upwards

explanation.surface: Someone picks up the floor mat as they say goodbye.
explanation.definitionFit: A tatami is a Japanese straw mat used as a floor covering, also a unit of room size.

clue.text: Gunner not so well with virtuoso around

indicators.note: the skilled performer stands around the comparative, holding it inside

parts.note: a virtuoso is a supremely skilled artist
more ill, so less well

explanation.surface: A soldier is feeling poorly with a brilliant performer nearby.
explanation.definitionFit: An artillerist is a soldier who handles big guns, an artilleryman or gunner.

clue.text: Drink, what teetotaller takes, giving up half? It may be painful for jogger

definitions.text: It may be painful for jogger

indicators.note: giving up half of a word means dropping half of its letters

parts.note: a nip is a small measure of spirits
a teetotaller takes the pledge, a vow to abstain from alcohol

explanation.surface: A reformed drinker gives up half their intake, while a runner suffers chafing.
explanation.walkthrough: PLEDGE loses its second half. Jogger's nipple is the painful chafing long-distance runners suffer.
explanation.definitionFit: A nipple rubbed raw by a shirt is a familiar injury for runners, hence painful.

clue.text: Charm e'er denied a driver of pack animals

indicators.note: to be denied something is to go without it, so these letters are removed

parts.note: taken as written
a muleteer drives mules
e'er, poetic for ever, is the part removed

explanation.surface: A mule driver has always lacked any lucky talisman.
explanation.walkthrough: MULETEER loses the EER of e'er at its end.
explanation.definitionFit: An amulet is a charm worn to ward off evil or bring luck, a talisman.

clue.text: Artist captivated by a Pacific climbing plant with bright blooms

indicators.note: in a down clue climbing goes upward, so the letters are read bottom to top

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: something captivated is held captive inside what captivates it

parts.note: irenic means peaceful, pacific
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: A painter is entranced by a Pacific climbing plant in bloom.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pacific' looks like the ocean but means peaceful. RA goes into A IRENIC, and the whole is read upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Cineraria is a daisy-like garden and pot plant noted for its vivid flower heads.

clue.text: Sexy youth, under the influence

definitions.meaning: first meaning: British slang for attractive young people, collectively
second meaning: an old Scots adjective for dizzy or tipsy

explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads as one tipsy young person; it is two meanings of one word.
explanation.definitionFit: Totty is British slang for sexually attractive people, and in Scots also means unsteady or drunk.

clue.text: Gouty old French leader admits grip failing finally

indicators.note: to admit is to let in, so the leader's name holds the other piece

parts.note: Jacques Chirac, former French president

indicators.note: the word fails at its end, so its last letter is lost

parts.note: taken as written, before losing its end

explanation.surface: A former French president, his grip weakening at last, has gout.
explanation.definitionFit: Chiragric describes chiragra, gout affecting the hand, so it is a gouty condition.

clue.text: He empties US bins, clothing togs spoilt with oil

parts.note: garb is clothing

indicators.note: something spoilt is damaged and disordered, so its letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written, as anagram fodder
taken as written, as anagram fodder

explanation.surface: A bin man's clothes are ruined by oil.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Clothing' looks like a container signal, but it is GARB, placed first.
explanation.definitionFit: Garbologist is a jokey American term for a garbage collector, someone who empties trash cans.

clue.text: Afghan city centre, centre moving eastwards

indicators.note: in an across entry east is rightwards, so the middle letter shifts one place right

parts.note: the heart is the centre of something

explanation.surface: The centre of an Afghan city is relocating towards the east.
explanation.walkthrough: The middle A of HEART moves one step right.
explanation.definitionFit: Herat is a major city in western Afghanistan, near the Iranian border.

clue.text: Glass ornament, uncommonly small one on back of cup

indicators.note: in an across entry one piece placed on another comes after it
the back of a word is its final letter

parts.note: last letter of cup
a runt is an unusually small animal, especially the smallest of a litter

explanation.surface: A tiny glass decoration sits on the back of a cup.
explanation.definitionFit: A prunt is a blob of glass fused onto a glass vessel as decoration.

clue.text: In the saddle, having a dance, once capering around (9, two words)

indicators.note: the jumbled letters sit around the dance, enclosing it
capering is skipping about playfully, so these letters jump into a new order

parts.note: taken as written, as anagram fodder
a ball is a formal dance

explanation.surface: A rider in the saddle once pranced about at a dance.
explanation.walkthrough: ONCE is shuffled to ENCO and wrapped around A BALL.
explanation.definitionFit: En caballo is Spanish for on horseback, a phrase used in English too.

clue.text: Boozer switching ends? one barely disturbs the surface

indicators.note: switching ends swaps the first and last letters of the word

parts.note: a tippler is a habitual drinker

explanation.surface: A drinker changing sides in a pub game; a light touch on the water's surface.
explanation.walkthrough: TIPPLER's first and last letters change places.
explanation.definitionFit: A ripplet is a small ripple, which only slightly ruffles the surface of water.

clue.text: Note scrawled by doctor: 'proceed with burying'

indicators.note: a scrawl is messy handwriting, so the letters come out in a jumbled order

parts.note: taken as written, as anagram fodder
MB is a Bachelor of Medicine, a doctor

explanation.surface: A doctor's illegible note instructs the undertaker to go ahead with the burial.
explanation.definitionFit: To entomb is to lay in a tomb, so as an instruction it means carry out the interment.

clue.text: Truly it requires courage going without bra

indicators.note: going without something means doing without it, so those letters are removed

parts.note: bravery is courage
taken as written, the part removed

explanation.surface: It truly takes nerve to go out braless.
explanation.definitionFit: Very is an old adjective and adverb sense meaning true, real or truly, as in the very truth.

clue.text: Unusually coiled tail denoting particular articulation?

indicators.note: unusually means in an irregular way, so the letters appear in an irregular order

parts.note: taken as written, as anagram fodder

explanation.surface: A strangely curled tail suggests some special joint.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Articulation' suggests a jointed tail, but it means speech.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiolect is one person's own way of speaking, so idiolectal describes an individual's particular speech.

clue.text: Trump (crucial) showing desire to catch up (7, two words)

parts.note: to long is to desire

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the letters are read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: to net a fish is to catch it

explanation.surface: A president's vital card play reveals a wish to catch up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Trump' suggests the politician but is a card term.
explanation.definitionFit: In some card games the long ten is the ten of trumps, often the card that decides a hand.

clue.text: A blow on limb seen in photo showing one severely handicapped

indicators.note: what is seen in a picture lies inside its frame

parts.note: pic is short for picture
taken as written
a rap is a sharp knock
a leg is a limb

explanation.surface: A photo of a leg injury showing a disabled person.
explanation.definitionFit: A paraplegic is a person paralysed in the lower body and legs.

clue.text: Went back over dosage unit before swallowed

indicators.note: something swallowed ends up inside whatever took it in

parts.note: the rad is a unit of absorbed radiation dose
ere is a poetic word for before

explanation.surface: Someone checked the label again: one measure of medicine before taking it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Before' looks like a joining word, but it is ERE.
explanation.definitionFit: Reread, past tense, means read again, that is, went back over a text.

clue.text: State founder adorning flag

parts.note: William Penn founded Pennsylvania
a decoration adorning something is on it

explanation.surface: A statue of a state's founder is decorated with a flag.
explanation.definitionFit: A pennon is a long narrow pointed flag, as carried on a lance.

clue.text: Good-time girl in midst of binge is happy

indicators.note: the answer lies in the midst of the following words, spanning their letters

parts.note: found inside the run of letters across the three words

explanation.surface: A party girl is happy in the middle of a drinking spree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Good-time girl' is a loose, slightly tongue-in-cheek gloss: a geisha is a hostess trained to entertain.
explanation.definitionFit: A geisha is a Japanese woman trained to entertain men with conversation, music and dance.

clue.text: We offered protection for sailors? I bone up on cases

indicators.note: in a down entry one piece placed on another sits above it

parts.note: CA is an abbreviation for cases

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the letters climb, so they read backwards

parts.note: taken as written
a rib is a bone

explanation.surface: A student cramming legal cases.
explanation.walkthrough: CA is a standard abbreviation for cases. The question mark flags that the gods are speaking as 'we' and are defined by what they did.
explanation.definitionFit: The Cabiri were ancient Greek mystery deities of Samothrace, invoked as protectors of seafarers.

clue.text: An old-fashioned carriage, line scrapped for bishop?

parts.note: the indefinite article

indicators.note: what is scrapped is thrown away, so those letters are removed

parts.note: a berline or berlin is an old four-wheeled covered carriage
taken as written, the part removed

explanation.surface: An antique coach has had its route cancelled and is now used for a churchman.
explanation.walkthrough: A bishop signs with an abbreviated see name, and Aber is short for Aberdeen, hence the question mark.
explanation.definitionFit: Aber, short for Aberdeen, can stand for that see's bishop in his signature, so it is defined by example.

clue.text: Fag, not good? Gives you rough breathing

indicators.note: not good means the letter standing for good is dropped

parts.note: gasper is old British slang for a cheap cigarette, a fag
G is the abbreviation for good

explanation.surface: Smoking is bad for you and leaves you wheezing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rough breathing' sounds medical but is a Greek accent mark; fag is British slang for a cigarette.
explanation.definitionFit: Asper is the Greek rough breathing mark, showing an initial h sound over a vowel.

clue.text: Employ volunteers kept within control

indicators.note: what is kept within something is held inside it

parts.note: to rein in is to control
the TA, Territorial Army, was Britain's volunteer reserve force

explanation.surface: Hire volunteers, and keep them under control.
explanation.definitionFit: To retain a lawyer is to engage or employ them by paying a fee in advance.

clue.text: I'm bowed, in rags, hobbling round Australia

indicators.note: the jumbled letters go round the abbreviation, enclosing it
hobbling is walking lamely and unevenly, so the letters are thrown out of order

parts.note: taken as written, as anagram fodder
A is the abbreviation for Australia

explanation.surface: A bent-over tramp in tatters limps around Australia.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bowed' suggests stooping, but means played with a bow.
explanation.definitionFit: The sarangi is a north Indian stringed instrument played with a bow, so it speaks as one bowed.

clue.text: Wipe foredeck up

indicators.note: in a down clue up means reading the letters from bottom to top

parts.note: the bows are the front part of a ship

explanation.surface: A sailor is told to mop the front deck.
explanation.definitionFit: Swob is a variant spelling of swab, to mop or wipe a ship's deck clean.

clue.text: Part of Crab or Lion between head of Pisces and tail of Capricorn

indicators.note: a piece placed between two others is enclosed by them
the head of a word is its first letter

parts.note: first letter of Pisces
Leo is the Lion of the zodiac

indicators.note: the tail of a word is its last letter

parts.note: last letter of Capricorn

explanation.surface: A zodiac puzzle: Cancer or Leo set between Pisces and Capricorn.
explanation.walkthrough: Crab looks like Cancer among the star signs, but here it is the crustacean.
explanation.definitionFit: The pleon is the abdomen of a crustacean such as a crab or lobster.

clue.text: Reel sailor's to tighten with rope

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a revolving reel for winding yarn or silk
second meaning: a nautical verb, to make tight by binding with ropes

explanation.walkthrough: 'Reel' suggests a sailor staggering, but it is a winding device.
explanation.definitionFit: A swift is a light adjustable frame for winding yarn, and to swift a vessel's capstan bars is to lash them taut.

clue.text: Fresh mount? he's supplied with troops on the move

indicators.note: things on the move change position, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written, as anagram fodder
taken as written, as anagram fodder

explanation.surface: A cavalryman with marching soldiers needs a new horse.
explanation.definitionFit: A posthorse was kept at a staging post so riders could swap a tired horse for a rested one.

clue.text: Rats etc? See one of them I dealt with round old lair

indicators.note: the mixed letters go round the old lair, enclosing it
cards dealt are shuffled first, so these letters are mixed up

parts.note: one of the rats in the definition
taken as written
O is the abbreviation for old
a den is an animal's lair

explanation.surface: Rats and their kin, one of which an old lag has handled near its burrow.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One of them' points back to the rats in the definition, so the clue reuses its own definition for a piece of wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Rodentia is the zoological order of gnawing mammals that includes rats, mice and squirrels.

clue.text: Joe maybe disheartened as Mac's well off

indicators.note: losing its heart means the middle letter of the name is taken out

parts.note: Joe Biden, US president, is one Joe

explanation.surface: Joe, downhearted, sees that a Scotsman is prosperous.
explanation.walkthrough: Mac's marks the definition as Scots; Mac stands for any Scot.
explanation.definitionFit: Bien (also bein) is a Scots word for comfortable or prosperous, well provided for.
